verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly touches this story. The CLI's `ng add` 'adds support for an external library to your project', and a community comment says third-party JS libraries like D3 integrate without bridges. The only UI library named is Material2, which is first-party and was described as incomplete at alpha, so no rich third-party component-library ecosystem is shown. Missing for 10: any named third-party UI component libraries, documentation of an ecosystem catalog or its breadth, independent corroboration that the ecosystem is rich.
